main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an integer, extracts its four decimal digits, tests the eight + and - operator combinations between the digits in a fixed order until one evaluates to 7, then prints the first matching expression and returns 0." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "Returns 0 after printing the successful expression."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare integer variables i, n, a, b, c, d, x, op1, op2, op3, and cnt; initialize cnt to 0 and define the operator array op with op[0]='+' and op[1]='-'. RESULT init_state]
            [COMMAND Read an integer from standard input into n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Extract the four decimal digits of n: set a=(n/1000)%10, b=(n/100)%10, c=(n/10)%10, and d=n%10. RESULT digits]
            [COMMAND Enter an infinite for(;;) loop. At the start of each outer-loop iteration, set x=0, op1=0, op2=0, and op3=0. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND Inside the outer loop, start a for loop with i=0; i<3; i++. The following branch-dependent evaluation is executed on each of the three identical iterations and overwrites x. RESULT inner_loop]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, if cnt<3 or cnt==4, set x=sum(a,b); otherwise set x=sub(a,b) and set op1=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4 and cnt<2, set x=sum(x,c). RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4, cnt<2, and cnt==0, set x=sum(x,d). RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4, cnt<2, and cnt!=0, set x=sub(x,d) and set op3=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4 and cnt>=2, set x=sub(x,c) and set op2=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4, cnt>=2, and cnt==2, set x=sum(x,d). RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the branch where cnt<3 or cnt==4, cnt>=2, and cnt!=2, set x=sub(x,d) and set op3=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the else branch where cnt>=3 and cnt!=4, if cnt==3 or cnt==6 set x=sum(x,c); otherwise set x=sub(x,c) and set op2=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the else branch where cnt>=3, cnt!=4, and (cnt==3 or cnt==6), if cnt==3 set x=sum(x,d); otherwise set x=sub(x,d) and set op3=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND During each inner-loop iteration, in the else branch where cnt>=3, cnt!=4, and cnt is neither 3 nor 6, if cnt==5 set x=sum(x,d); otherwise set x=sub(x,d) and set op3=1. RESULT x]
            [COMMAND After the inner loop, if x==7, break out of the infinite loop. RESULT termination_flag]
            [COMMAND After the inner loop, if x!=7, increment cnt by 1 and continue to the next outer-loop iteration. RESULT cnt]
            [COMMAND Handle cnt greater than or equal to 7 by continuing to compute x=sub(sub(sub(a,b),c),d) and setting op1=op2=op3=1 on every subsequent outer-loop iteration until x==7; if it never equals 7, the loop runs forever. RESULT infinite_loop_behavior]
            [COMMAND After breaking out of the loop, print the expression using op[op1] between a and b, op[op2] between b and c, and op[op3] between c and d, followed by the literal text =7. RESULT output]
            [COMMAND Return 0. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
